claims.text: The driver's own trace shows he held position inside the pickup geofence for only 181 seconds, one second short of the 180-second free waiting period in force for this STANDARD-zone trip — but the record's own arithmetic reports the shortfall as -1.0 seconds against the longest qualifying run, and the platform's own wait timer started at 20:36:59 and the driver cancelled at 20:39:58, a span of 179 seconds. Either way the effective in-geofence dwell did not exceed the free waiting period, so the cancellation fee is not chargeable and must be refunded in full.

The trip_record's own wait timer confirms the shortfall: the free waiting period of 180 seconds started at 20:36:59 and the driver terminated the trip at 20:39:58, only 179 seconds later. The driver's own statement that he 'waited the free period then cancelled' is contradicted by the platform's own telemetry, which shows he cancelled before the free period elapsed.

The rider's device was stationary throughout the waiting window — the rider track shows a single distinct speed of 0.0 kph across 41 fixes — and the rider's mean distance from the pin was 877.6 m, which is outside the 100 m rider-presence radius for a STANDARD zone. The rider was not at the pickup point, but that is irrelevant to the fee: POL-NS-06 makes the waiting-period shortfall strict liability, refunding the fee 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages.'

The driver's arrival marker was not false: the trace places him inside the geofence from 20:36:57, the same timestamp as his 'I'm Here' tap, and his speed at that moment was 0.0 kph, well below the 15 kph motion threshold. POL-NS-05 therefore does not displace the fee, and the case turns on the dwell shortfall under POL-NS-06.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup road: EV-ADVIS-02718-01 is MISSING with a BLOCKING issue code, so POL-NS-06(i) cannot be invoked to accumulate dwell across separate in-geofence intervals. The trace shows only one in-geofence interval in any event, so there is no second interval to sum. The shortfall stands and the full refund is payable.

The fare_breakdown confirms the rider was charged SGD 4.50 as a cancellation fee with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The amount to be refunded is the cancellation-fee line only, SGD 4.50, and no driver compensation is payable because POL-NS-06 provides that where cumulative dwell falls short of the minimum, 'the full refund stands and no driver compensation is payable.'

The driver's profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 0 and completed_trips_30d of 62, so the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip and the case does not escalate on that ground. But the anti-farming check is irrelevant here because POL-NS-06 already displaces the fee entirely: the driver is not entitled to compensation on a premature cancellation.

The rider's profile shows no_show_disputes_30d of 1, below the threshold of 3 that would trigger escalation under POL-NS-09(d), and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0 on both sides, so POL-NS-09(c) does not apply. The case is decidable on the record and does not require human review.

claims.text: The driver's own trace places him inside the pickup geofence for a continuous 181 seconds, from 20:36:57 to 20:39:58, and the free waiting period in force for this STANDARD-zone trip is 180 seconds under trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec. The dwell therefore meets the minimum by one second, and POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied on the driver's own evidence.

The trip_record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 20:36:57 and a wait_timer_started event at 20:36:59, and the GPS trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 20:36:57 — the same second. POL-NS-01 limb (a) is satisfied and limb (b) is satisfied because the driver was inside the geofence at or before the arrival event, so the arrival marker is not false and POL-NS-05 does not displace the clock.

The trip terminated at 20:39:58 by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, and the termination falls after the 180-second dwell elapsed at 20:39:57. Limb (d) is satisfied.

The rider's own track places her device 874 to 881 metres from the pickup pin throughout the waiting window, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider_presence_radius_m for a STANDARD zone. She was not at the pickup point, and the driver's message 'im at the pickup point' sent at 20:37:17 and read at 20:37:47 went unanswered.

The fare_breakdown charges exactly SGD 4.50, which reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50 for this trip, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and the amount is the net figure POL-NS-01 fixes. The charge stands and POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of that net figure, SGD 3.60.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, which is below the 4-or-more limb, and 0 divided by completed_trips_30d of 62 is 0.0, which is not greater than 0.08. Both limbs are required and neither holds, so compensation is paid rather than withheld.

The rider's claim that the driver 'cancelled almost immediately' is contradicted by the record: the driver was assigned at 20:32:01, tapped arrived at 20:36:57 after a 4.9-minute approach, and cancelled at 20:39:58 — three minutes and one second after arriving, having served the full free waiting period. The rider's characterisation is not supported.

POL-NS-06 does not rescue the rider. The accumulated in-geofence dwell is 181 seconds, which is not shorter than the 180-second minimum, so the shortfall limb does not fire; and in any event limb (i) is unavailable because EV-ADVIS-02718-01 is MISSING — no traffic advisory covers this pickup road — so no separate intervals could be summed even if there were more than one.

POL-NS-03 does not apply on these facts: the driver's stationary fixes are inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, not outside it but within 400 m, so this is not a wrong-entrance case and no goodwill payment under POL-NS-03(ii) arises. The registered_pickup_points count of 1 confirms a single pickup point, not a pin-ambiguity situation.

The rider's own cancellation grace under POL-NS-10 does not apply because the rider did not cancel — the driver terminated the trip. The rider's cancellation_rate of 0.041 and account_age_days of 661 are context only under POL-GEN-01 and are not cited as a ground of decision.

ruling.explanation:
Decision for both parties. On the record this is a genuine rider no-show: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee stands and the driver is paid SGD 3.60.

The rider's case. You say the driver cancelled almost immediately and before the free waiting period elapsed, pointing to the platform wait timer, which started at 20:36:59 and stopped at the 20:39:58 termination, 179 seconds. That reading is rejected. POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the driver's 'I'm Here' tap and not from the wait timer. The GPS trace EV-GPS-02718 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup geofence continuously from 20:36:57 to 20:39:58, a dwell of 181 seconds against the 180-second free waiting period in force (EV-TRIP-02718, platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180); the record's own derived shortfall is -1.0 s, a surplus. Your POL-NS-06 shortfall claim therefore fails and nothing is refundable on that ground. Your further point that you were not at the pickup point is correct - your device sat 874 to 881 m from the pin throughout (41 fixes, all 0.0 kph) - but it does not help you, because POL-NS-04 requires a locating message from you and the only chat message (20:37:17) was the driver's. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes were inside the arrival radius, not outside it within 400 m.

The driver's case. All four POL-NS-01 limbs hold: (a) the trip record carries an 'arrived' event at 20:36:57; (b) the trace puts you in the geofence at that same moment; (c) the dwell of 181 s meets the 180 s minimum; (d) the trip was terminated by you at 20:39:58 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell elapsed. Your marker is not false under POL-NS-05: at 20:36:57 you were in the geofence at 0.0 kph, neither more than 300 m out nor moving at 15 kph or above. The fare breakdown EV-FARE-02718 charges exactly SGD 4.50, matching the fee in force, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect.

Money. The SGD 4.50 charge stands (as to the fee, POL-GEN-03 NO_ACTION means the present state is left in place and the rider's claim is not supported), and POL-NS-07 fixes your payout at 80% of the SGD 4.50 net fee = SGD 3.60, the residual SGD 0.90 being retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming bar does not apply (EV-DPROF-02718: no_show_terminations_30d is 0, below the 4-or-more limb), so compensation is paid rather than withheld.

Evidence, weight and escalation. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact - EV-GPS-02718, EV-TRIP-02718, EV-FARE-02718, EV-DPROF-02718 - is at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is not impaired. The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02718-01 (weight 0.0) carries no deciding fact: it bears only on POL-NS-06(i), which cannot run in any event because there is no shortfall and only one in-geofence interval. Two side-claims that cited it without naming its MISSING_ARTIFACT issue code were discarded by the referee for undisclosed impairment. No POL-NS-09 ground applies: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, POL-NS-01(c) fixes which clock governs so the wait-timer and GPS readings are not an unresolved contradiction, neither party shows cross-party disputes in the trailing 90 days, and the anti-farming check does not trip. The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes on issue.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the disputed amount is the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee on trip TRP-02718, charged to the rider and held in fare_breakdown (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The fee stands and the driver is compensated.

Why the fee stands. The driver was assigned at 20:32:01, the trip_record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 20:36:57, and the GPS trace (coverage 100%, 10 s cadence, no gaps) places the driver inside the STANDARD-zone pickup geofence from 20:36:57 through the cancellation at 20:39:58 - a continuous qualifying dwell of 181 seconds across 19 in-geofence fixes. The free waiting period in force is trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180 seconds. POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, expressly not from the 'arrived' event, so 181 s meets the 180 s minimum by one second, and all four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold: (a) arrived event present; (b) the driver was in the geofence at the arrival timestamp; (c) dwell at least the free waiting period; (d) no boarding event and the trip terminated by the driver at 20:39:58 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell elapsed at 20:39:57.

The rider's claims on the shortfall are rejected on the clause's own terms. The argument that the dwell was only 179 seconds measures from the wait_timer_started event at 20:36:59, which POL-NS-01(c) does not use as the start of the measure. The argument that the record's shortfall figure of -1.0 seconds shows a deficit misreads the sign: a negative shortfall means the longest qualifying run exceeded the required minimum by one second. POL-NS-06 therefore does not fire, and limb (i) of it is in any event unavailable because only one in-geofence interval exists and EV-ADVIS-02718-01 is MISSING. POL-NS-05 does not displace the clock either: at the arrival timestamp the driver was inside the geofence at 0.0 km/h, well under the 15 km/h motion threshold, so the arrival marker is genuine and no false-arrival referral arises under POL-NS-05(ii).

Other routes considered. POL-NS-03 does not apply - the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it but within 400 m - so no wrong-entrance refund and no pin-ambiguity goodwill is payable. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: she sent no locating or coordinating message (the only chat message is the driver's, at 20:37:17), and her own track places her 875-881 m from the pin, outside the 100 m rider-presence radius, so limb (c) is affirmatively failed on admissible fixes and the clause does not apply in any event. POL-NS-10 does not apply because the rider did not cancel; the cancellation grace limb concerns a rider's own cancellation.

Money and confidence. The fare_breakdown charges exactly SGD 4.50, which reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 (below the 4-or-more limb) and 0/62 completed trips is 0.0 (not above 0.08), so compensation is paid rather than withheld. It is 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 net fee, i.e. SGD 3.60. The case does not escalate: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1 (below 3), both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, no admissible artifacts contradict each other, no deciding artifact is impaired, and confidence is above the 0.70 floor. On this ruling the rider's SGD 4.50 charge stands, amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.60 figure as driver_compensation_sgd per POL-GEN-03, and the monetary effect (SGD 3.60) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically.

Evidence weight. The facts above are carried by EV-GPS-02718 and EV-TRIP-02718, each at weight_multiplier 1.0, and by EV-FARE-02718 and EV-DPROF-02718 at 1.0; the cap on confidence is therefore 1.0. EV-ADVIS-02718-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 and carries no fact; it is not needed, and two claims advanced on it were discarded for not disclosing its MISSING_ARTIFACT impairment.

ruling.explanation:
This rider-filed dispute is over a $4.50 cancellation fee, and the fee stands. The driver was assigned at 20:32:01, tapped 'I'm Here' at 20:36:57 after a 4.9-minute approach, and cancelled at 20:39:58 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The rider's account that the driver 'cancelled almost immediately' is not supported by the trip record.

POL-NS-01 is satisfied on all four limbs. (a) the trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 20:36:57. (b) the GPS trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at that same second, so the driver was inside the 50 m STANDARD geofence at the arrival marker, and the marker is not false under POL-NS-05 (his speed there was 0.0 kph, well under the 15 kph motion threshold). (c) the driver's longest continuous qualifying run inside the geofence runs from 20:36:57 to 20:39:58, a dwell of 181 seconds, which meets the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). (d) the trip was terminated by the driver under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three recognised codes, at 20:39:58 - one second after the required dwell elapsed.

The rider's POL-NS-06 shortfall argument is rejected. It measures 179 seconds from the wait-timer start at 20:36:59. POL-NS-01(c) and POL-NS-06 both measure the effective in-geofence dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix - here 20:36:57 - and not from the 'arrived' event or the wait timer. On the policy measure the dwell is 181 seconds, one second MORE than the minimum; the record's own derived shortfall of -1.0 seconds is negative for exactly that reason. There is no shortfall, so POL-NS-06 does not fire and no full refund follows. POL-NS-03 does not apply because the driver's stationary fixes are inside the arrival radius, not outside it but within 400 m. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: the only chat message is the driver's own, so there is no locating or coordinating message from the rider to answer, and the rider's own track places her device about 877 m from the pin throughout, outside the 100 m STANDARD radius.

Because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, the fee is not refundable and POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the net $4.50 fee, or $3.60. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d is 0 against a threshold of 4, and 0 of 62 completed trips is not above 0.08), so compensation is paid rather than withheld. Under POL-GEN-03 the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and amount_sgd carries the same $3.60 as driver_compensation_sgd; the rider's charge of $4.50 stands.

No clause produces a referral: the arrival marker was not false, so POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire; POL-NS-07's anti-farming branch does not fire; and no route-deviation clause is in play.

On weight: every artifact carrying a deciding fact - the GPS trace, the trip record, the fare breakdown and the profiles - is at full weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is high. ruling.explanation: To both parties: the no-show cancellation fee stands, and the driver is paid the compensation it funds. The record shows the driver was assigned at 20:32:01, tapped 'I'm Here' at 20:36:57, and cancelled at 20:39:58 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. POL-NS-01 requires four things and all four hold. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 20:36:57. (b) The GPS trace places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at or before that event: the first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 20:36:57, the same second, and the trace carries 19 qualifying in-radius fixes. (c) The driver held position inside the geofence for the free waiting period in force for this trip, 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec): POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, 20:36:57, to the last, 20:39:58, which is 181 seconds. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver under RIDER_NO_SHOW (a recognised code) at 20:39:58, after the required dwell elapsed at 20:39:57.
ruling.explanation_claims: The rider's claims that the fee must be refunded under POL-NS-06 are rejected. The rider argues the wait timer ran only 179 seconds (20:36:59 to 20:39:58), but POL-NS-01(c) expressly measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the arrival event or the wait timer, and on that clock the dwell is 181 seconds — one second beyond the 180-second minimum. The record's own shortfall figure of -1.0 seconds states a surplus, not a deficit; POL-NS-06's strict-liability refund applies only where the dwell falls short, and it does not. The rider's own track (41 fixes, a single speed of 0.0 kph, 874 to 881 m from the pin, outside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius) shows the rider was not at the pickup point; that supports the no-show but is not needed for the fee. POL-NS-04 does not apply — it exonerates a rider only where the rider messaged during the waiting window, and the only message in the chat log is the driver's at 20:37:17 ('im at the pickup point'); the rider sent nothing, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. POL-NS-05 does not apply — the arrival marker is not false, the driver was stationary at 0.0 kph inside the geofence at 20:36:57, so no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-03 does not apply — the stationary fixes are inside the arrival radius, so this is not a wrong-entrance case, and registered_pickup_points is 1. The rider's characterisation that the driver 'cancelled almost immediately' is contradicted: the driver served the full free waiting period after a 4.9-minute approach.
ruling.explanation_money: The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02718) charges SGD 4.50, which reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and the fee stands as charged. POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the net fee: 0.8 x SGD 4.50 = SGD 3.60. The anti-farming check does not trip — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, below the 4-or-more limb, and 0/62 is not greater than 0.08 — so compensation is paid rather than withheld. Per POL-GEN-03, on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling amount_sgd carries the same figure as driver_compensation_sgd, SGD 3.60; that is the amount this ruling moves, and the rider's charge is not refunded.
ruling.explanation_weight: Confidence is capped by the artifacts that carry the deciding facts. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02718, weight_multiplier 1.0), the trip record (EV-TRIP-02718, 1.0) and the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02718, 1.0) all carry no issue codes and no down-weighting under POL-GEN-02, so the cap is 1.0. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02718-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0; it is not relied on and carries no fact. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; the trip record and GPS trace do not contradict each other on arrival or dwell (the policy's own measurement rule resolves the two-second difference between the first fix and the wait timer); disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both sides; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below 3; the anti-farming check does not trip; and no deciding fact rests on impaired evidence. The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this provisional ruling executes automatically. No clause in force produces a referral on these facts.
